orbits.name: Low Earth Orbit (LEO)
orbits.description: Close to Earth: easy comms, but atmospheric drag limits lifetime.

orbits.name: Sun-Synchronous Orbit (SSO)
orbits.description: Constant sunlight for power; consistent lighting for imaging.

orbits.name: Geostationary Orbit (GEO)
orbits.description: Fixed over one longitude; great for comms, poor Earth coverage.

orbits.name: Sun-Earth L1
orbits.description: Uninterrupted solar view; requires station-keeping fuel.

orbits.name: Low Lunar Orbit
orbits.description: Close lunar mapping; limited comms windows from Earth.

orbits.name: Low Mars Orbit
orbits.description: Mars surface observation; long cruise phase required.
